# 6D Torsional Action Principle Architecture & Hubble Tension Resolution

An open-source mathematical physics framework establishing a six-dimensional torsional action principle over an extended spacetime configuration manifold to resolve the cosmological Hubble tension.

## Metadata & Academic Identifiers
- Author: Phillip A. Longo (2026)
- ORCID Registry: https://orcid.org/0009-0004-3537-6478
- Primary Theoretical Thesis DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22234910
- Technical Supplement & Parameter Index DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23508912
- Active Simulation Repository: https://github.com
- Public Interactive Dashboard: https://philliplongo.github.io/torsional-action-hubble-tension/
- Open Source License: GPL-3.0
- Data Statement: All 26-module verification datasets, simulation outputs, and computational parameters are available open-access within the repository directories.

## Core Theoretical Framework
- Manifold Geometry: M^4 × (R^+ × S^1) extended configuration manifold architecture.
- Geometric Core: Einstein-Cartan-Sciama-Kibble (ECSK) geometry utilizing standard 3+1 ADM foliation over a topologically invariant 4π double-loop covering domain.
- Field Proxies: Multi-scale chameleon scalar fields coupled to a density-dependent effective potential V_eff(Φ, ρ_b).
- Hubble Resolution: Baseline Hubble Constant H_0 = 73.04 km/s/Mpc achieved via a 10.73% compression of the comoving sound horizon scale (r_s*), driven by a peak early dark energy fraction of f_EDE = 0.0712 around critical redshift z_c ≈ 3500.

## Observational & Laboratory Falsifiability Matrix
- Terrestrial Casimir Forces: Shift to a distinct d^-6 power-law scaling profile at sub-micron scales under highly polarized ferromagnetic boundary configurations.
- Superconducting Circuits: Induced non-thermal geometric decoherence voltage spectral density manifesting as a characteristic 1/ω noise signature scaling with the temporal phase gradient (∂_t Φ)^2. Target room-temperature (293.15 K) coherence protection plateau limits bounded at 78.97%.
- Astrophysical Photon Discrepancy: Multi-messenger timing-delay phase shift of 1.3013 × 10^-10 seconds for photons relative to gravitational wave counterparts emitted at redshift z = 2.0.
- Space Missions Compliance: Explicitly structured for validation via next-generation cosmological datasets including CMB-S4 (E-mode polarization fractions) and Euclid/Roman space telescopes (matter power spectrum Jeans-suppression parameters fixed at α = 0.005).
- Numerical Compatibility: Formatted with native prior boundaries matching standard CAMB/CLASS Boltzmann solver modifications and Cobaya MCMC pipeline integration blocks.
